about: The module that implements each engine's part, by engine, kept apart from engine_knobs.json so a reader of the knob rows does not load the adapters. adapter: the module workflow/tune.py loads (tune.table merges it into engines.<E>) to read that engine's build, supply its facts, run its measured points and write its command. mtp: the module collectors/mtp.py loads to measure the engine's multi-token prediction.
